props.title: Acoustic duos and trios in Colorado Springs.
props.lede: A pair of guitars is one of the easiest ways to bring live music to an event in The Springs. A duo fits on a patio, in a hotel lobby or beside the dinner tables, and two musicians can play anything from flamenco to the songs everybody knows.

headingText.html: Here are the duos and trios we’d suggest for Colorado Springs, including a married violin and guitar duo who live there. Planning a bigger party? Learn more about private parties in Colorado Springs.

props.title: Duos and trios for Colorado Springs
Which acoustic duo is right for your Colorado Springs event?

rows.text: Grace Easley and Gordon Lewis are a married violin and guitar duo from Colorado Springs. They play Romanian and Eastern European folk tunes, old-time ballads and a little swing, and both trained as classical musicians, so they’re a lovely choice for a ceremony or a dinner.

This is the one to book when you’d like songs everybody knows. It’s voice and guitar, or guitar and upright bass if you’d rather keep it instrumental, and a third musician makes it a trio when you want a fuller sound.
Dirty Flamenco plays real flamenco and rumba on guitar, and it’s a great choice for a dinner party, a garden party or a company dinner with some flair.
Jazz standards on guitar and upright bass are a sophisticated pick for a cocktail hour or a client dinner, and they’re easy to talk over.

items.q: Can an acoustic duo play outdoors in Colorado Springs?
items.a: Yes. The duo needs a level spot with shade or cover and power nearby, and we’ll plan an indoor backup with you in case the weather turns.

items.q: How much space does an acoustic duo need?
items.a: Not much, about 8 by 6 feet. That’s why a duo works so well on a patio or in a lobby where a band wouldn’t fit.

items.q: Can the same duo play the ceremony and the reception?
items.a: Yes. Roma Ransom and the acoustic duo can both play a ceremony and then keep going through cocktails and dinner, so just tell us about both parts when you reach out.

props.title: Send us the date and your Colorado Springs venue, and we’ll suggest a duo.
props.lede: Let us know roughly how many guests, too, and whether you’d like songs with vocals or something instrumental.
